revealPolicy.label: Full sanitized public daily slate
revealPolicy.rule: All sanitized daily display rows are embedded in the public site. Receipts, logs, source workbooks and model internals stay local.

wnba.Headline: Fever beat Aces again as Caitlin Clark scores 12 in 24 minutes
wnba.Description: The Fever beat the defending champion Aces in Las Vegas for the second time in eight days. Caitlin Clark, who has been dealing with back issues, played 24 minutes and finished with 12 points, 7 rebounds and 6 assists.

wnba.Headline: Kelsey Mitchell, Caitlin Clark lead Fever to 109-75 win over A'ja Wilson and the Aces
wnba.Description: — Caitlin Clark had 12 points, seven rebounds and six assists, Kelsey Mitchell scored 27 points, and the Indiana Fever beat A'ja Wilson and the Las Vegas Aces 109-75 on Sunday night.

wnba.Headline: Las Vegas Aces vs. Indiana Fever - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Las Vegas Aces vs. Indiana Fever, 07/12/2026

wnba.Headline: Bueckers' 22 points, 11 rebounds help Wings beat Sky 96-81, extend win streak to 5 games
wnba.Description: — Paige Bueckers had 22 points and 11 assists, Jessica Shepard added 19 points and 10 rebounds, and the Dallas Wings beat the Chicago Sky 96-91 on Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Dallas Wings vs. Chicago Sky - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Dallas Wings vs. Chicago Sky, 07/12/2026

wnba.Headline: Betnijah Laney-Hamilton ejected after tossing shoe that hit Marina Mabrey
wnba.Description: The Tempo outlasted the Liberty 93-91 Sunday in Montreal after an eventful fourth quarter that saw New York's Betnijah Laney-Hamilton ejected for tossing a shoe that hit Toronto's Marina Mabrey in the back.

wnba.Headline: Toronto Tempo vs. New York Liberty - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Toronto Tempo vs. New York Liberty, 07/12/2026

wnba.Headline: Mabrey scores 30, Tempo blow 20-point lead but beat Liberty 93-91 in Montreal
wnba.Description: — Marina Mabrey scored 30 points, Nyara Sabally made the tiebreaking basket with 52 seconds left after Toronto blew a 20-point lead, and the Tempo beat the New York Liberty 93-91 on Sunday at the Bell Centre.

wnba.Headline: Shakira Austin scores 10 of her 27 points in the 4th quarter as the Mystics beat the Storm 84-79
wnba.Description: — Shakira Austin scored 10 of her 27 points in the fourth quarter, Kiki Iriafen had 12 points and 13 rebounds for her ninth double-double this season, and the Washington Mystics beat the Seattle Storm 84-79 on Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Washington Mystics vs. Seattle Storm - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Washington Mystics vs. Seattle Storm, 07/12/2026

wnba.Headline: Pebley out as Sparks GM, assistants to share interim role
wnba.Description: Raegan Pebley is out after two and a half years as the Sparks' general manager, the team announced Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Mercury lose by 48 in third-biggest blowout in WNBA history
wnba.Description: Mercury coach Nate Tibbetts said his team "can't have any more of these" after Saturday night's 48-point loss to the Aces, the third-worst blowout in WNBA history.

wnba.Headline: Minnesota plays Phoenix after McBride's 25-point outing
wnba.Description: Phoenix Mercury (8-16, 5-9 Western Conference) at Minnesota Lynx (17-6, 10-1 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Las Vegas hosts Indiana following Mitchell's 29-point performance
wnba.Description: Indiana Fever (13-9, 5-4 Eastern Conference) at Las Vegas Aces (17-6, 12-4 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Toronto hosts New York following Mabrey's 34-point game
wnba.Description: New York Liberty (13-10, 8-1 Eastern Conference) at Toronto Tempo (9-13, 4-6 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Ogwumike leads Los Angeles against Atlanta after 25-point outing
wnba.Description: Los Angeles Sparks (10-11, 5-6 Western Conference) at Atlanta Dream (13-10, 7-3 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Aces beat Mercury 106-58 to match the third-biggest win in WNBA history
wnba.Description: — A'ja Wilson had 21 points and 15 rebounds in just 25 minutes as the Las Vegas Aces routed the Phoenix Mercury 106-58 on Saturday night in one of the worst blowouts in WNBA history.

wnba.Headline: Las Vegas Aces vs. Phoenix Mercury - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Las Vegas Aces vs. Phoenix Mercury, 07/11/2026

wnba.Headline: Fire put 7 in double figures in 102-92 win over Dream, who play without injured Reese
wnba.Description: — Megan Gustafson scored 17 points, two others had double-doubles and the Portland Fire held off the Atlanta Dream, who were without All-Star Angel Reese, 102-92 on Saturday.

wnba.Headline: Atlanta Dream vs. Fire - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Atlanta Dream vs. Fire, 07/11/2026
